test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence:

"The preliminary results have been officially announced by the matriculation board."

options.text: The matriculation board has officially announcing the preliminary results.
The matriculation board has officially announced the final results.
The matriculation board will has officially announced the preliminary results.
The matriculation board has officially announced the preliminary results.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice.
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object of the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The preliminary results have been officially announced by the matriculation board."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "the matriculation board" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "have been officially announced" to "has officially announced" (present perfect active).
 
• Ensure the object "the preliminary results" follows the verb for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The matriculation board has officially announced the preliminary results."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The matriculation board has officially announcing the preliminary results." – Incorrect verb form (present participle instead of present perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The matriculation board has officially announced the final results." – Incorrect object ("final results" instead of "preliminary results").
 
• **Option 3: **"The matriculation board will has officially announced the preliminary results." – Incorrect verb structure ("will has" is grammatically incorrect).
